entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's garbage and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Look, don't waste my time. Just send me the return label. I'm looking at your website right now, it says 90 days.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see you received it on December 15th. Before I proceed, I do need to ask: What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter! I don't like it. It's uncomfortable and the battery dies too fast. I just want my money back. Your policy is your policy.
I understand, sir. It's just that for devices like the Pulse that are worn directly on the skin, there are often stricter rules for hygiene and sanitation purposes once it's been used.

Hygiene? Are you kidding me? I'm not sick! Are you trying to find an excuse? I've had it for 22 days! Your website says 90! Don't you dare tell me it's too late. This is exactly the kind of runaround I expected. Get me your supervisor!
Sir, there's no need for that, please allow me just a moment to review the official policy information in my system. I don't want to give you any incorrect information.
You better not. I will light up every review site on the internet if you try to deny this. I'm looking at the policy right now. Ninety. Days.

Okay... one moment... You know what, sir, you are absolutely correct. I apologize. My internal knowledge base clearly states a 90-day return window. You are well within that period. I can process this return for you immediately.
See? I told you so. So you're sending the label?

Yes, I am. I've just authorized the return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Fine. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, my apologies for the confusion. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
